scope: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, fixed prefix4940, 25% exact block budget, online P8. Freeze backbone; retain per-layer query/generation KV.
exploration: Run all legal grid points regardless of previous statistical noninferiority results; candidates remain unvalidated. Stop only failing numerical/storage contracts, not quality stop rules.

data.explore768: Previously observed v24 dev; structure selection only.
data.final1536: New unused train5500 pool holdout; exclude all earlier bundled questions/prefix examples; unopened for evaluation until selected G and checkpoints frozen.
data.test500: Historically observed regression, not structural selection.

selection.rule: Among successfully trained expanded G in [24,22,20,16,14], select smallest G where at least one R seed24 development accuracy is within 1 percentage point of contemporaneous v25 identity. This point-estimate screening is not NI certification. If none, select G24 as predefined diagnostic fallback. Retain BOTH R0 and R4 at selected G.
selection.replicates: Add seeds25 and26 to both R using identical frozen v24 seed24 initializer; no further selection from final1536 or test500.

final_acceptance.paired_method: Unchanged conservative paired benefit-minus-harm beta bound
final_acceptance.rule: For each of two preselected R routes, require all three fixed seeds to meet the bound; intersection across seeds, Bonferroni across two routes. No automatic deployment. Report R4-vs-R0 descriptively; no best-seed selection.

timing.curve: All seed24 G/R plus identity: SSD-cold/preserve, 2 repeated blocks of 16 fixed historical queries, forward/reverse arm order. Exploratory curve, no strong interval claim from only two blocks.
timing.selected: Selected G R0/R4 and identity receive two further preserve blocks (4 total), four native cold blocks of16, and four ordinary-cache blocks of32; balanced cyclic arm order and fresh process per arm, runtime warmup8 retained. Exact cache cold controller unchanged; R4 files included.
timing.isolation: No own training/evaluation concurrent with formal timing; independent server-only Pcache copies. Other pre-existing GPU jobs are not stopped.
timing.profile: Separate Nsight/VizTracer 8-query diagnostic captures for identity and selected R4; excluded from formal TTFT.

accounting: Use v25 total base+native repair bytes, reader resident+packed bytes separately, hardware H2D separately, all current-query KV private. No persistent SSD copies deleted, no claim total model memory reduction.
constraints: Preserve original prism_pans and all existing implementations/results. All artifacts server-side. No 14B run: current single-GPU BF16 implementation and 24GiB GPUs cannot hold full14B weights.
